# ButtonsCLI

> ButtonsCLI Native is a free, MIT-licensed terminal app written in Rust for Windows, macOS and Linux. It is built for people who would rather click: command buttons, tiled panes, per-pane themes and fonts, AI-generated GPU shader backgrounds, and AI agent control over MCP or a CLI.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://buttonscli.com/): what ButtonsCLI Native is, screenshots, and downloads
- [Docs](https://buttonscli.com/native/docs/): user guide for ButtonsCLI Native
- [Full docs as text](https://buttonscli.com/native/docs/llms-full.txt): the whole guide in one file
- [Short docs as text](https://buttonscli.com/native/docs/llms-small.txt)
- [Source and releases](https://github.com/detroittommy879/buttonscli-native): code and the latest release downloads
